title: hymenophyllum polyanthos var. sturmii
intro: Hymenophyllum polyanthos var. sturmii, commonly known as Sturm's filmy fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is native to Australia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Sturm's filmy fern include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial effects.
